front: What is the difference between `git fetch` and `git pull`?
back: `git fetch` downloads commits, files, and refs from a remote repository without merging; `git pull` does a `git fetch` followed immediately by a `git merge`.
Temporarily shelves (stashes) changes you've made to your working copy so you can work on something else, and then reapply them later.
When Git has checked out a specific commit rather than a branch, meaning any new commits won't update any branch pointer.

front: How do you undo the last commit but keep the changes in your working directory?
What is the purpose of `git rebase`?
back: To apply commits from one branch on top of another branch to create a linear history.
